title: Riot Squad BAR EDTN Pink Lemonade 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid 10mg
description: Riot Squad BAR EDTN Pink Lemonade captures the essence of summer with every puff. This e-liquid flavour features a zesty lemonade base combined with a mix of sweet, juicy summer berries, creating a truly refreshing and intensely fruity flavour. With its 50VG/50PG formulation, this e-liquid delivers an optimal balance of flavour and vapour production. The nicotine salt formula ensures a smooth and comfortable throat hit, making Riot Squad’s BAR EDTN e-liquids perfect for starter vape kits and low-powered pod devices. Nicotine salts, unlike traditional freebase e-liquids, allow for higher nicotine concentrations without the harsh throat hit. These salts are absorbed into the bloodstream faster, providing quick relief from nicotine cravings. This makes Nic salt e-liquids an excellent choice for recent ex-smokers or vapers seeking immediate and satisfying nicotine relief. Inspired by Riot Squad’s popular disposable Riot Bar flavours, BAR EDTN offers a delectable range of nic salt e-liquids. Just like the Riot Bars, Bar EDTN keeps the flavours straightforward, sweet, and reliably enjoyable, so you always know what to expect. Try Pink Lemonade and explore the rest of Riot Squad’s BAR EDTN range, including Watermelon Ice, Cherry Cola, and Mango Vanilla. Whatever your preference, BAR EDTN has a flavour that’s perfect for you.
